KAIOD v4.0 — Ultimate Edition
🔗 Web: getkaiod.github.io

⚡ What is KAIOD?
KAIOD is a modern glassmorphism UI Roblox script built for chaos. Kill players, drag them, launch them into the void — all with a clean, animated interface.

📌 How To Use
Get a tool from the shop first (any random item works).

Paste the script and execute.

Type a player name or random into the target box.

Pick your action and have fun.

🎯 Core Features
Kill — Can kill players. Select by name or random.

Target ESP — Highlights your target with a live distance tag.

Dual Sliders — Adjustable Speed (0.5x – 3.0x) and Power (1.0x – 5.0x) multipliers.

Player Dropdown — Instantly pick from a list of players.

PageDown keybind — Toggle the GUI anytime.

💥 Action Menu
🖐️ Drag — Left click to drag the target, [Q] to stop.

❄️ Freeze — Locks the target in place. (Currently patched — doesn't work.)

🚀 Launch — Sends the target flying upward.

🌀 Spin — Spins the target around rapidly.

🌍 Earthquake — Shakes the target across the map.

🎲 Toss — Hurls the target to a random location.

🕳️ Blackhole — Pulls the target toward you.

⚡ Super Fling — Extreme fling. Bypasses anti-fling.

⚰️ Bring — Teleports the target directly to you.

🔨 Slam — Slams the target into the ground repeatedly.

⚡ Electro Jitter — Violent random jittering.

🕳️ Sinkhole Trap — Slowly sinks the target underground.

💫 Orbit Shield — Orbits the target around your position.

📍 Click TP — Press, then click anywhere on the map to teleport the target there.

🌪️ Tornado — Spirals the target upward.

🔀 Version Switch
The GUI has a Version Button in the header.

Base version is v3.9 (Physics Mode).

Press the v3.9 button → you switch to v4.0 (Touch + CFrame Mode).

Press again to switch back.

Each version uses a different movement/attack system — try both to see which works better for your game.

                local footPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                local rootPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)

                end
            else

            end
        else

        end
    end

    espButton.Text = espEnabled and "ESP: ON" or "ESP: OFF"
    espButton.BackgroundColor3 = espEnabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(160, 45, 45)
        or Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 75)
    updateESP()
end)

-- TELEPORT TO SELECTED PLAYER
local function teleportTo(target)
    if target == player then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local targetCharacter = target.Character
    if not character or not targetCharacter then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRoot = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root and targetRoot then
        root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 0, 0)
    end
end

local function refreshPlayers()
    for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if target ~= player then
            local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
            button.Name = "Player_" .. target.UserId
            button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 80, 125)
            button.Text = target.Name
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            button.TextSize = 15
            button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            button.Parent = list
            round(button, 8)

            button.Activated:Connect(function()
                teleportTo(target)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function watchPlayer(target)
    if target == player then return end

    target.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if target.Parent == Players then
            createESP(target)
        end
    end)

    if target.Character then
        createESP(target)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(target)
    watchPlayer(target)
    refreshPlayers()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(target)
    removeESP(target)
    refreshPlayers()
end)

for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(target)
end

refreshPlayers()
